authorship_preservation_hypotheses: Quote/dash mapping changes typography while preserving authorship and most content.
Digit masking preserves original authorship but removes potentially meaningful numerical content; a stress diagnostic, not realistic attack evidence.
A prefix retains original authorship but removes content and changes length/whitespace; not a pure length intervention or proven hidden-test attack.

bootstrap.method: Paired, class-stratified percentile bootstrap of original document IDs; fixed models/split, no selection or training-variation correction.

conditions.digit_runs_to_zero: Python Unicode-aware re.sub(r'\d+', '0', passage); full canonical validation IDs.
conditions.prefix_100_on_min150: Keep first 100 whitespace-split words joined by one ASCII space; compare with unchanged original text on exactly canonical IDs having >=150 whitespace words.
conditions.quote_and_dash: Apply existing frozen quote_typography then dash_typography mappings together; full canonical validation IDs.

limitations: Post-public-feedback exploratory diagnostics. No observed condition identifies hidden domains, attacks, or causes of the public gap. No candidate selection or export.
